commitQuest(bytes32,uint8).details: The commit-reveal scheme works as follows: 1. Player generates random seed off-chain 2. Player commits hash of seed (can't change after) 3. Wait for blocks to pass (randomness source) 4. Player reveals original seed 5. Final random = keccak256(playerSeed, blockHash) This prevents: - Miners from manipulating block hash after seeing seed - Players from choosing seed after seeing block hash

params.commitHash: Hash of player's secret seed: keccak256(playerSeed)

returns._0: questId The ID of the new quest

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.playerSeed: The original seed that was hashed in commit
